productOnPage.descriptionHtml:
Join Ryder, Liberty, Everest, Tracker, and all of your favorite PAW Patrol pups in eight new audio adventures based on the hit TV series. Featuring character voices and the famous PAW Patrol theme song, listeners will get to know four members of the PAW Patrol. Each card includes an introduction to the pup, two PAWsome adventures featuring that pup as the hero, and a pup quiz.

Included in this pack is:


Ryder: No job is too big, no pup is too small! Ryder is the leader of the PAW Patrol, and the only human member of the team! He’s always there to lead the pups through each and every rescue, inventing awesome new gadgets along the way. Featuring “Pups Save Ryder’s Robot” and “Pups Save a Good Mayor.”


Liberty: Let’s boogie! Liberty is the PAW Patrol’s city rescue pup, and she’s always ready to zip into action on her scooter! From rescuing runaway radar dopplers to rounding up lost baby animals on a girl pup roadtrip, there’s no problem Liberty can’t solve! Featuring “Liberty’s Mountain Rescue” and “Liberty’s Road Trip Rescue.” 

Everest: Ice and snow, Everest is ready to go! Everest is the PAW Patrol’s mountain rescue pup. Although she lives up on Jake’s Mountain, she’s always there to lend a paw, especially when the mission involves snow! From saving a snowbound cow to reuniting a baby penguin with her colony, there’s no adventure too big for Everest! Featuring “Pups Save the Lost Penguin” and “Pups Save a Snowbound Cow.”

Tracker: Tracker is all ears! His supersized ears give him super-hearing skills, and along with his ability to speak and understand both English and Spanish, there’s no rescue too tough for Tracker! From wrangling a runaway elephant to returning a baby capybara back to her family, Tracker is the perfect pup to save the day, especially when it involves the local wildlife! Featuring “Pups Save the Elephant Spa” and “Pups Save a Capybara.”


Featuring the voices of: Jess Kaliban and Mateo Acevedo, Justin Badger, Dan Bittner, Micaiah Chen, Samiyyah El-Amin Turner, Connor Esterson, Kolbe Garza, Adriella Goncalves, Ethan Hatt, Cari Kabinoff, William Luke III, Piotr Michael, Cheyenne Omani, Sean Quinn-Hanley, Isaac Robinson-Smith, Carlos Velasquez, Olivia Sarafina Washington, Thomas Whittington, and Henry Witcher.
productOnPage.descriptionMarkdown:
**_Yoto Says: The pups are back! Join Ryder, Everest, Tracker, and Liberty for more adventures, more quizzes, and more paw-tastic fun!._**

Join Ryder, Liberty, Everest, Tracker, and all of your favorite PAW Patrol pups in eight new audio adventures based on the hit TV series. Featuring character voices and the famous PAW Patrol theme song, listeners will get to know four members of the PAW Patrol. Each card includes an introduction to the pup, two PAWsome adventures featuring that pup as the hero, and a pup quiz.  
  
Included in this pack is:  
  
  
  
  
Ryder: No job is too big, no pup is too small! Ryder is the leader of the PAW Patrol, and the only human member of the team! He’s always there to lead the pups through each and every rescue, inventing awesome new gadgets along the way. Featuring “Pups Save Ryder’s Robot” and “Pups Save a Good Mayor.”  
  
  
  
  
Liberty: Let’s boogie! Liberty is the PAW Patrol’s city rescue pup, and she’s always ready to zip into action on her scooter! From rescuing runaway radar dopplers to rounding up lost baby animals on a girl pup roadtrip, there’s no problem Liberty can’t solve! Featuring “Liberty’s Mountain Rescue” and “Liberty’s Road Trip Rescue.”   
  
Everest: Ice and snow, Everest is ready to go! Everest is the PAW Patrol’s mountain rescue pup. Although she lives up on Jake’s Mountain, she’s always there to lend a paw, especially when the mission involves snow! From saving a snowbound cow to reuniting a baby penguin with her colony, there’s no adventure too big for Everest! Featuring “Pups Save the Lost Penguin” and “Pups Save a Snowbound Cow.”  
  
Tracker: Tracker is all ears! His supersized ears give him super-hearing skills, and along with his ability to speak and understand both English and Spanish, there’s no rescue too tough for Tracker! From wrangling a runaway elephant to returning a baby capybara back to her family, Tracker is the perfect pup to save the day, especially when it involves the local wildlife! Featuring “Pups Save the Elephant Spa” and “Pups Save a Capybara.”  
  
  
  
  
Featuring the voices of: Jess Kaliban and Mateo Acevedo, Justin Badger, Dan Bittner, Micaiah Chen, Samiyyah El-Amin Turner, Connor Esterson, Kolbe Garza, Adriella Goncalves, Ethan Hatt, Cari Kabinoff, William Luke III, Piotr Michael, Cheyenne Omani, Sean Quinn-Hanley, Isaac Robinson-Smith, Carlos Velasquez, Olivia Sarafina Washington, Thomas Whittington, and Henry Witcher.

Tracks included:

*   Introduction
*   All About Ryder
*   Pups Save Ryder's Robot
*   Pups Save a Good Mayor
*   Ryder Quiz
*   Credits

From saving a snowbound cow to reuniting a baby penguin with her colony, there’s no adventure too big for Everest! Featuring “Pups Save the Lost Penguin” and “Pups Save a Snowbound Cow.”  
  
Tracker: Tracker is all ears! His supersized ears give him super-hearing skills, and along with his ability to speak and understand both English and Spanish, there’s no rescue too tough for Tracker! From wrangling a runaway elephant to returning a baby capybara back to her family, Tracker is the perfect pup to save the day, especially when it involves the local wildlife! Featuring “Pups Save the Elephant Spa” and “Pups Save a Capybara.”  
  
  
  
  
Featuring the voices of: Jess Kaliban and Mateo Acevedo, Justin Badger, Dan Bittner, Micaiah Chen, Samiyyah El-Amin Turner, Connor Esterson, Kolbe Garza, Adriella Goncalves, Ethan Hatt, Cari Kabinoff, William Luke III, Piotr Michael, Cheyenne Omani, Sean Quinn-Hanley, Isaac Robinson-Smith, Carlos Velasquez, Olivia Sarafina Washington, Thomas Whittington, and Henry Witcher.

Tracks included:

*   Introduction
*   All About Ryder
*   Pups Save Ryder's Robot
*   Pups Save a Good Mayor
*   Ryder Quiz
*   Credits
